title: Green preparation of shell-based biochar and its adsorption of multi-component chlorinated volatile organic compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2462-2474
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07060K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dan He, Jiao Wang, Wei Deng, Jiangbo Xiong, Meijuan Lu, Xiang Tu, Chenglong Yu
This study applies a green method combining sodium phytate and sodium hydroxide to prepare hierarchical porous biochar from shell-based biomass waste (e.g., pomelo peel, mandarin orange peel, orange peel, rice husk, and peanut shell).
